decision.comment: Model search stage is well-executed and internally consistent. All 5 architecture families (compact_transformer, residual_cnn, resnet18, tiny_cnn, vision_transformer) were evaluated across 8 trials with 0 failures. The progressive budget (3→6→9 epochs) culminated in selecting resnet18_wider_cw (hidden=48, class_weighting=true) with validation accuracy 99.40% and macro-F1 99.39% at best_epoch=8/9. Data audit passed all checks with zero train/val overlap; test is locked and uninspected. Augmentations (hflip, rotate180, brightness) are all built-in primitives requiring no extension approval. Transformer-specific fields (num_heads, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, mlp_ratio, tokenizer_layers) present in the ResNet18 config are inactive for CNN families per pipeline rules and do not constitute a hybrid. The depth=3 field is ignored for ResNet18's fixed topology, as expected. Two minor observations (neither deterministic): (1) label_smoothing=0.1 slightly exceeds the architecture-research recommendation of 0.0–0.05 for CNN heads, though it is a common and defensible value and the validation result is strong; (2) weight_decay=0.001 is below the suggested 0.01 for conv layers, again a minor deviation that did not impair performance. The final train_config extends epochs to 15 with patience=3, a reasonable extension beyond the 9-epoch search budget. No issues warrant revision or stop.
issues: Label smoothing 0.1 for ResNet18 (CNN) slightly exceeds the architecture-research recommendation of 0.0–0.05 for CNN heads; validation performance is unaffected but worth monitoring in the final 15-epoch run.
Weight decay 0.001 is below the research-suggested 0.01 for conv stem/LayerNorm; minor deviation with no observed negative impact.

No clinical claims. The supplied current UTC timestamp is authoritative. This pipeline uses the standard 28x28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; do not substitute the source-dataset or MedMNIST+ resolution. Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
